paragraphs: From Woodview, depart Kilbranish Drive and take the 1st right to stay on Kilbranish Drive
Take the next right onto Woodview Park turn left onto Old Cratloe Road
Continue to the roundabout and take it slight left onto Cratloe Road, staying straight on the exit
Follow Cratloe Road as it becomes Sexton Street North and then High Road
Turn right onto Glenview Terrace bear slight right onto Thomond Row
Continue along Farranshone Road, and at the end of the road turn left onto Shelbourne Road
Turn left onto Ennis Road and follow it straight as it becomes Sarsfield Bridge and then Sarsfield Street
At the lights turn right onto O'Connell Street and continue through the city section
Turn right onto Lower Mallow Street, then at Shannonbridge Roundabout go straight through, taking the slight left exit onto the R527
Turn right onto Shelbourne Road Lower, and at the next roundabout take the slight left exit to stay on Shelbourne Road Lower
Turn left onto Mayorstone Drive and continue as it becomes Coolraine Estate
At the fork, bear slight right onto Avondale Drive
Turn left onto Parkview Drive at the end of the road turn right, still on Parkview Drive
Continue left as it becomes Lissadell Drive turn right onto Merval Drive, left onto Mayorstone Upper, and left onto Cratloe Road
At the roundabout take the left exit onto Old Cratloe Road
Turn right to continue on Old Cratloe Road turn left onto Kilbranish Drive
Take the 1st right, then the next right onto Woodview Park, and left onto Old Cratloe Road again
At the roundabout, go slight left onto Cratloe Road and continue straight on the exit
Turn right onto Mayorstone Upper, continue straight as it becomes Coolraine Estate
Bear slight left at the fork onto Lansdowne Park
At the roundabout take the left exit to stay on Lansdowne Park
At the end of the road turn right onto Ennis Road, then finish on the left to return toward the Woodview test centre
